dedupe_keys.name: sdg indicator 9 1 1 rural access index 2023 release sedac

description: Part of SEDAC's SDG indicators collection, this data set estimates SDG indicator 9.1.1, the Rural Access Index: the proportion of the rural population living within 2 km of an all-season road. It was computed as the share of WorldPop gridded rural population within 2 km of an all-season road from OpenStreetMap, for 209 countries and 45,073 subnational units, at national level and level-2 subnational resolution. It responds to the UN view that rural road access underpins poverty reduction, food security, health access and trade. Coverage is global. Access: free CSV, geodatabase and shapefile downloads on Harvard Dataverse under CC BY 4.0, released September 2025. Caveats: the all-season classification depends on OpenStreetMap road tags and completeness, and a 2 km buffer ignores terrain and river crossings. The index supports accessibility and equity analysis of rural road networks, prioritisation of road investment and exposure of isolated populations to network disruption in hazard studies. It complements the SDG 11.2.1 urban public transport release and the GRIP global roads data catalogued here.
